On Fri, Aug 27, 2027 at 11:21 AM stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Laura — thanks for the heads up...

Team — initial findings: between 08:24 and 09:05 EDT we saw a surge in concurrent short-running chat requests from Nimbus that bypassed our prefix cache and forced a high volume of KV-cache loads. This produced transient contention on the dedicated pool serving their tenant and raised TPU/GPU dispatch latency. Error pattern: 502/504 timeouts on model shards during resharding retries.

Remediation steps we’ve kicked off (in progress):
- Rollback of an internal kernel routing tweak for this pool (complete).
- Temporarily increase pool burst capacity (+30%) and shift some traffic to a secondary pool in us-east-1 (in progress).
- Enable additional retry/backoff at the router for Nimbus requests to avoid hammering during reshard.

I’ll post a runbook summary to the ticket and a timeline in 20 min. If the customer needs faster fallbacks, we can route them to a slightly lower-cost model variant with verified compatibility.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
